name: app/form-field
title: FormField
summary: Label, control, hint and error wired together: the label is always visible, the hint and error are the control's description, and an error sets aria-invalid. The control is an input, a textarea or a native select.

props.name: name
props.description: The field name; the id is `field-<name>`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type (an input only). A file input never carries a value.

props.name: as
props.description: The control: an input, a textarea or a native select.

props.name: options
props.description: A select's options; the one whose value is `value` is selected.

props.name: emptyOption
props.description: A select's first, empty option (e.g. "Choose a type"), selected when there is no value.

props.name: rows
props.description: A textarea's rows.

props.name: accept
props.description: A file input's accepted types (e.g. "image/*").

props.name: multiple
props.description: A file input that takes several files.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value of a number or date input.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value of a number or date input.

props.name: step
props.description: Step of a number or date input.

props.name: wide
props.description: Spans both of FormLayout's columns (`@xl:col-span-2`).

props.name: hint
props.description: Help under the field.

props.name: error
props.description: The error under the field.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label "(required)" and the input required.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Read-only, on a muted fill. A select is disabled instead (a select has no read-only state), so it is not posted.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: Autocomplete token.

props.name: maxlength
props.description: Maximum length.

props.name: inputmode
props.description: Virtual keyboard hint.

behaviour: "(required)" is written in the label, not shown by an asterisk alone.
aria-describedby lists the hint and then the error.
A textarea and a select get the same id, name, required, aria-describedby and aria-invalid as an input, at the same app density.
A select with `emptyOption` starts with an empty option, selected when there is no value.
A file input never carries a value; its file-selector button is a muted pill. With a file field, FormLayout needs `enctype="multipart/form-data"`.

textarea.description: A textarea with a hint and an error.

select.description: A select with an empty first option and no value.

select-readonly.description: A read-only select with a value: disabled, its option selected.

file.description: A file input for several images, spanning both columns.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Fills its column; 16px text on touch so iOS never zooms.
`wide` spans both columns of FormLayout's container grid from @xl.
contract:
contract
  slot is "form-field"
  uses label
  uses input
  when default shows label "(required)"
  when textarea class contains "@xl:col-span-2"
  when file class contains "@xl:col-span-2"
end

checks.say: The input is described by hint and error.
The label points at the input.
A textarea is wired as an input is.
The textarea's label points at it.
A select is wired as an input is.
The empty option comes first and is selected with no value.
A read-only select is disabled, its value selected.
Without emptyOption there is no empty option.
A file input takes types and several files, and never a value.
A number input carries its bounds.
